preconditions.description: The number of points on the mountain is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= h_j < h_{j+1} <= 10**12 for j in range(n-1))
preconditions.description: Heights are strictly increasing and within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(h_j >= h_{j+1} - 2 for j in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: After the landslide, each height is at most 2 less than the next height.

postconditions.expression: all(h_j <= h_{j+1} for j in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: After the landslide, heights remain in non-decreasing order.
